tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Did you go out last night?
tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: I went out although I was tired.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Did you enjoy the match?” (Add did.)

B hears the question and builds the answer. Choose from the tile although / despite: although + a clause (although it was cold), despite + a noun or -ing (despite the cold). Change the blue verb if you need to.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Although + clause. Despite + noun or -ing. 'In spite of' means the same.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?

tandemFragen.antwort: We enjoyed it despite the rain.

tandemFragen.frage: Why did you buy that jacket? It's so expensive.
tandemFragen.antwort: I bought it although it was expensive.

tandemFragen.frage: Why is Liam at work? He's ill.

We had a great time despite the bad weather.

tandemFragen.frage: Did Amira pass her driving test?

tandemFragen.frage: It's raining. Why are you walking to work?

tandemFragen.frage: Why did you take the job? The pay is low.
